semantic_fragments.content: ME equipment complied with its specifications and all requirements of the standard when operated in normal use within temperature +5°C to +40°C, relative humidity range of 15% to 90% non-condensing (not requiring water vapour partial pressure greater than 50 hPa), and atmospheric pressure range of 700 hPa to 1060 hPa. For more restricted range, 10°C–40°C is used and described in the Product Specifications section of User's Manual.

ME equipment for home healthcare environment is classified as Class II and internally powered, not provided with a functional earth terminal, and equipped with Type BF applied parts. It is not permanently installed and not intended to be operated in a carrying case.

Accessibility test per IEC 60601-1-11 clause 5 and IEC 60601-1 sub-clause 5.9.2.1: accessible parts identified by inspection and testing. Small finger probe (Fig 1) applied in bent or straight position for all normal use positions. No access covers requiring tools and no parts such as lamps, fuses, or fuse holders requiring lay operator access.
